capabilities: Renders @@@ permission blocks with chips, frames and nesting
Shows fragment markers and side-by-side column regions
Inserts tags and blocks from a context menu and commands
Generates dated semester tables of lessons
Builds per-student sections and invitation lists from a school directory
disambiguation: Not a Markdown formatter: it displays SafeLearn's tags as visual aids and never changes the file.
extras: Directory picker, invitation lists and class listing need a configured safeLearn instance and a Keycloak login; the Keycloak client must be created once by the instance administrator. All tag rendering and writing commands work offline with no account.
motivation: Shows what SafeLearn will do with your document while you write it.
problem: SafeLearn's directives are instructions to the server rather than readable text, so while writing a teacher cannot see who a block admits or how it will be laid out.

relations.evidence: SafeLearn is an open-source server that publishes a teacher's Markdown behind a school login.
Content that appears one step at a time in a Reveal.js presentation.
The identity provider your instance authenticates against.

summary: Displays SafeLearn's own Markdown tags — restricted blocks, fragments and columns — as visual aids in the editor and reading view.
